WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
),
l AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, s.region, p.category, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount,
         w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AS has_order, w.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) AS m, vat_class, vat_rate, (store_id=900) AS web, store_id=999 AS s999, category='ZZ Test' AS zz,
  COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(net_amount) AS net, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND NOT has_order THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_no_order
FROM l
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, date_trunc('month', business_date) AS m, SUM(net_amount) AS net FROM l
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, date_trunc('month', business_date) AS m, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) AS store_id, COALESCE(a.m,b.m) AS m, a.net AS mine, b.net AS ctl, a.net-b.net AS diff
FROM mine a FULL JOIN ctl b ON a.store_id=b.store_id AND a.m=b.m
WHERE a.net IS NULL OR b.net IS NULL OR abs(a.net-b.net)>0.05
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'orphan_store' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND s.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_product', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND s.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_version_mismatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND NOT (f.sale_date BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'capital_region_lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND s.region='Capital Region'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_wrong_store', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND ((s.store_id=900) <> (f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_cancelled_or_proc', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31' AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected')

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024_gross_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
